notes.title: v1.0.9 Patch Note
notes.notes: Minor QoL updates related to switching between fullscreen/windowed modes

notes.title: v1.0.8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list][*] Perfect Mode has been removed from Story Mode. Easy Mode has been added, and Easy Mode is now the default game mode in Story Mode.
[*] Fixed several bugs.
[*] Minor QoL updates.[/list]
[h3][strike]Known Issue[/strike][/h3]
[list][*] [strike]Leaderboard in Challenge Mode not working properly (Unable to save and load records)[/strike] Fixed[/list]

notes.title: PsychoFlux Ent. 4th Anniversary Sale
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6188768/efab4791c242911d7fb384c5bab6381370169683.png[/img]

On [b]March 26th[/b] 2020, we have reached our [b]4th anniversary[/b] milestone. In the recent days we have finally begun to produce good results, but there's still much to be done. Thank you for everyone's continuous support.

To celebrate our anniversary, we're holding a special promotion! Get the games we're publishing at a discounted price this weekend.

The discount rate goes up to [b]75%[/b], and has been applied to most of our games on Steam. The offer ends around [b]March 30th and 31st[/b], so don't miss the chance!

Visit our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/PsychoFlux]publisher page on Steam[/url] to find out which games are on sale.

notes.title: v1.0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list][*] Now the mouse cursor will be hidden from the screen if you leave it for a while.
[*] Fixed an issue where the sound effects of electric traps continues to play, even while the game was paused.[/list]

notes.title: Day One Patch (v1.0.1.1) Notes
notes.notes:
[list][*] Enabled [b]Perfect Mode[/b] (Clear all stages in Normal Mode to unlock)
[*] Improved sound effects[/list]

notes.title: Bouncing Hero is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're glad to inform you that 'Bouncing Hero' is now available on Steam today. Bouncing Hero is a hardcore platformer co-developed by ZPink and zniq.

The price is $4.99(USD) and will be discounted to $3.34(USD) 'till September 9th. Get the game and jump right in!

Hope you enjoy the game! Thanks a lot.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/999990/Bouncing_Hero/
